text:
Jamal: Quick follow-up from last night's outage — we saw a recurring KV-eviction + cold-start pattern. Need concrete owners + timelines to turn the remediation into deterministic tests (regression prompt sets, load/soak, chaos drills). Who can take what? cc @Elaine @Zoe @Andy

Elaine: I can own the prompt-set curation + adding assertions to the eval harness. Will extract incident prompts and canonicalize.

Zoe: I can handle load/soak and baseline k6 configs. Estimate ~2 sprints to cover soak + alerting.

Andy: I'll own chaos drills (KV eviction simulations) and runbook updates. Plan weekly runs in sandbox, 3 iterations, then expand to staging.

sre-bot: Incident CL-3421 tagged "recurring-kv-eviction" and linked to the incidents board.

Jamal: Good. Elaine — can we add prompt-level pass/fail assertions (exactness + semantic fuzz) so regressions auto-alert?

Elaine: Yes. Plan: add 20 canonical prompts pulled from the incident, plus a few negative cases. Will open ticket + PR.

Zoe: Draft k6 snippet for the soak test (prototype):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.test/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: '...'}));
}
```
Command: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m` — will parameterize later.

Andy: Chaos approach: use chaos-mesh in the sandbox to evict KV pods and simulate cold-start. Need a short checklist + rollback steps. Also will ensure Dedicated fallback policy is exercised.

Jamal: Let's capture explicit action items and owners for tracking: 1) Elaine — incident prompt-set + eval assertions (ticket CL-3433) — due 2026-04-10; 2) Zoe — k6 soak + alert thresholds (ticket CL-3434) — due 2026-04-24; 3) Andy — chaos drill + runbook updates (ticket CL-3435) — due 2026-04-17. Maria — can you add these to the triage board and create recurring reminders?

Maria: On it. I'll add the cards to the Triage board, set assignees, and create calendar slots for the weekly chaos runs.

Zoe: :thumbsup: I'll also add baseline throughput/latency targets to CL-3434 and a short checklist for environment parity (staging vs prod).

Elaine: PR opened with initial prompts + harness changes: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-evals/pull/128 — needs reviewers @Jamal @Andy.

Jamal: I'll review today and drop comments.

Andy: Noted. Also flag: ensure Dedicated fallback routing is explicitly covered in the chaos playbooks and the load test includes a burst stage to validate routing policies.

sre-bot: Reminders created for CL-3433, CL-3434, CL-3435 on 2026-03-28.

Maria: Added items to sprint planning board — they're tentatively in sprint 2026-04-01. If owners need different timelines ping here.

Elaine: Quick question — do we want to version the prompt sets alongside model versions? I think yes for traceability.

Jamal: Yes, version prompts and tie to model / quantization profile in the eval metadata. Add a short schema to the PR.

Zoe: Will include metadata fields: model_version, seq_len_profile, expected_latency.

Andy: I'll coordinate with Eng-Infra for sandbox chaos permissions and request a small quota bump for the soak runs.

Jamal: Thanks all. We'll close the loop in two weeks — please escalate blockers here. If anyone finishes early, post the run logs/artifacts (s3 link or gist) so we can automate baselines.

Elaine: Uploaded initial prompt list to Gist: https://gist.github.com/rw/incident-prompts-001

Zoe: Prototype k6 script and metrics dashboard link posted in CL-3434 card.

Andy: First chaos run scheduled for 2026-03-31 in sandbox. I'll post notes after run #1.

Maria: Calendar invites + triage board links posted.

Jamal: Great work — closing this thread for now but will re-open if we need to coordinate across teams. :white_check_mark:
